relations.support_notes: The cover page title of (ID:5523) identifies the "dharma simha" of the colophon as Cha pa Chos kyi seng ge (ID:3831).

comments:
The same scholar, identified in the colophon as "dharma singha" (=Tib. chos kyi seng ge) composed this commentary on the Mūlasarvāstivādiśrāmaṇerakārikā (ID:3764) and on the Mūlasarvāstivādiśrāmaṇerakārikāvṛtti (ID:3766), see (ID:4509).
He is likely the same person who composed a So thar mdo'i 'grel ba (ID:4507), whose colophon likewise names the author "dharma singha."

Whether the author is Phya pa Chos kyi seng ge (ID:3831) remains to be confirmed, notably upon systematic comparison with another commentary on the °kārikā titled dGe tshul rnams kyi bslab pa'i rim pa ston pa'i rnam par bshad pa (ID:4511), the colophon of which names the author "chos kyi seng ge" and indicates he was a disciple of Bya 'dul (ID:3818).
The present work has parallels to (ID:4511), but is more detailed has more frequent mention and refutation of alternative views. However, (ID:4511) refers more systematically to the base text.
Parallels with the anonymous (ID:5253) should also be explored further.

Other candidates for the authorship, see (ID:6566), and Phya pa's students (ID:3844) and (ID:3853).
